en: So let's dive into these AI tools we can use
as a developer, and we'll start with GitHub
Copilot, which
arguably is the most established and oldest
AI assistant we can use as developers
because it was initially released back in
June 2021. So even before this entire
AI hype started with ChatGPT and so on.
So it's a really old tool,
a really old assistant, but of course it has
evolved over all those years. It got much
better and it's more capable than ever
nowadays.
And therefore in this section, we'll of
course explore what exactly it is because it
is way more than it was
a couple of years ago.
We'll take a look at how we can use it with
the Tab key, how we can take advantage of
suggestions and completions offered by
GitHub Copilot.
We'll explore its chat functionality and
we'll take a look at a feature called
Copilot Extensions.
And along the way, we'll take a look at many
other useful features, use cases, and of
course, Tips and tricks on how to use it
efficiently.
